description: This source file defines the 'I18NLanguage' entity class in the OrangeHRM system, representing a language for internationalization support. It includes properties such as 'id', 'name', 'code', 'enabled', 'added', and 'modifiedAt', along with corresponding getter and setter methods. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and a trait for datetime helpers.

classes.name: I18NLanguage
classes.description: Entity class representing a language used in internationalization, mapped to the 'ohrm_i18n_language' database table.

methods.description: Returns the ID of the language.
